totems.note: Spell Totem Support summons a totem, but neither its stats nor a skill table name a SkillTotemVariations key. SkillTotemsKey 1, 2 and 3 (StrengthTotem, DexterityTotem, IntelligenceTotem) are used by no ActiveSkills row, and every skin of the three has the same monster type, multipliers, tags, skills and mods; only the model differs. Key 1 stands for all three. Which model the game shows follows the supported gem's colour, which changes no value.
totems.source: Our reading of GrantedEffects, ActiveSkills, SkillTotemVariations and MonsterVarieties in 3.28.0.16 and 3.29.3.3; the model by gem colour as Path of Building CalcActiveSkill.lua chooses it

totems.note: Ballista Totem Support adds the TotemsAreBallistae skill type, but neither its stats nor a skill table name a SkillTotemVariations key. Key 12 holds the ballista totems (SnipeTotem and its skins), the key of Siege Ballista. Skin 0 of key 12 has the same monster type, multipliers, skills and mods as skin 0 of keys 1 to 3; it lacks only the mud_blood tag.
totems.source: Our reading of GrantedEffects, ActiveSkills, SkillTotemVariations and MonsterVarieties in 3.28.0.16 and 3.29.3.3

totems.note: Earthbreaker Support's stat set has the implicit stat support_totem_type_override_to_support_slam_ancestor, which names Totems/SupportAncestorSlamTotem, skin 0 of key 20. Key 20 is used by no ActiveSkills row. Its varieties have life multiplier 120% and monster type AncestorTotem, where keys 1 to 3 have 100% and Totem.
totems.source: Our reading of GrantedEffectStatSets, ActiveSkills, SkillTotemVariations and MonsterVarieties in 3.28.0.16 and 3.29.3.3
